plans.name: normal/dashboard service 1_year
plans.sql:
WITH scoped_accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM expense_tracker.accounts
  WHERE user_id=$1 AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR id=$2)
    AND ($3::text IS NULL OR status=$3)
), transaction_totals AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, sum(CASE WHEN t.type='income' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS delta,
    sum(CASE WHEN t.type='income' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS income,
    sum(CASE WHEN t.type='expense' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS expenses
  FROM expense_tracker.transactions t JOIN scoped_accounts a ON a.id=t.account_id AND a.user_id=t.user_id
  WHERE t.user_id=$1 GROUP BY t.account_id
), transfer_entries AS (
  SELECT t.source_account_id AS account_id, -t.amount AS delta
  FROM expense_tracker.transfers t JOIN scoped_accounts a ON a.id=t.source_account_id AND a.user_id=t.user_id
  WHERE t.user_id=$1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.destination_account_id AS account_id, t.amount AS delta
  FROM expense_tracker.transfers t JOIN scoped_accounts a ON a.id=t.destination_account_id AND a.user_id=t.user_id
  WHERE t.user_id=$1
), transfer_totals AS (
  SELECT account_id,sum(delta) AS delta,
    sum(CASE WHEN delta>0 THEN delta ELSE 0 END) AS incoming,
    sum(CASE WHEN delta<0 THEN -delta ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing
  FROM transfer_entries GROUP BY account_id
), account_balances AS (
  SELECT a.*, COALESCE(t.income,0::numeric) AS income, COALESCE(t.expenses,0::numeric) AS expenses,
    COALESCE(f.incoming,0::numeric) AS incoming, COALESCE(f.outgoing,0::numeric) AS outgoing,
    a.opening_balance + CASE WHEN a.type='credit_card' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END
    * (COALESCE(t.delta,0::numeric)+COALESCE(f.delta,0::numeric)) AS balance
  FROM scoped_accounts a LEFT JOIN transaction_totals t ON t.account_id=a.id
    LEFT JOIN transfer_totals f ON f.account_id=a.id
)
  SELECT COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN type='credit_card' THEN -balance ELSE balance END),0::numeric)::text AS "netPosition",
    COALESCE(sum(balance) FILTER (WHERE type<>'credit_card'),0::numeric)::text AS assets,
    COALESCE(sum(balance) FILTER (WHERE type='credit_card'),0::numeric)::text AS "cardDebt"
  FROM account_balances

plans.name: normal/dashboard service 1_year
plans.sql:
SELECT t.id,t.account_id AS "accountId",a.name AS "accountName",
  t.category_id AS "categoryId",c.name AS "categoryName",t.type,t.amount::text AS amount,t.description,
  to_char(t.transaction_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date,t.recurring_transaction_id AS "recurringTransactionId",

  JOIN expense_tracker.categories c ON c.id=t.category_id AND (c.is_system OR c.user_id=t.user_id)
  WHERE t.user_id=$1 ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC,t.created_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT 5

plans.name: stress/accounts repository
plans.sql:
WITH scoped_accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM expense_tracker.accounts
  WHERE user_id=$1 AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR id=$2)
    AND ($3::text IS NULL OR status=$3)
), transaction_totals AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, sum(CASE WHEN t.type='income' THEN t.amount ELSE -t.amount END) AS delta,
    sum(CASE WHEN t.type='income' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS income,
    sum(CASE WHEN t.type='expense' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS expenses
  FROM expense_tracker.transactions t JOIN scoped_accounts a ON a.id=t.account_id AND a.user_id=t.user_id
  WHERE t.user_id=$1 GROUP BY t.account_id
), transfer_entries AS (
  SELECT t.source_account_id AS account_id, -t.amount AS delta
  FROM expense_tracker.transfers t JOIN scoped_accounts a ON a.id=t.source_account_id AND a.user_id=t.user_id
  WHERE t.user_id=$1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t.destination_account_id AS account_id, t.amount AS delta
  FROM expense_tracker.transfers t JOIN scoped_accounts a ON a.id=t.destination_account_id AND a.user_id=t.user_id
  WHERE t.user_id=$1
), transfer_totals AS (
  SELECT account_id,sum(delta) AS delta,
    sum(CASE WHEN delta>0 THEN delta ELSE 0 END) AS incoming,
    sum(CASE WHEN delta<0 THEN -delta ELSE 0 END) AS outgoing
  FROM transfer_entries GROUP BY account_id
), account_balances AS (
  SELECT a.*, COALESCE(t.income,0::numeric) AS income, COALESCE(t.expenses,0::numeric) AS expenses,
    COALESCE(f.incoming,0::numeric) AS incoming, COALESCE(f.outgoing,0::numeric) AS outgoing,
    a.opening_balance + CASE WHEN a.type='credit_card' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END
    * (COALESCE(t.delta,0::numeric)+COALESCE(f.delta,0::numeric)) AS balance
  FROM scoped_accounts a LEFT JOIN transaction_totals t ON t.account_id=a.id
    LEFT JOIN transfer_totals f ON f.account_id=a.id
)
  SELECT id,name,type,currency,status,opening_balance::text AS "openingBalance",
    NOT opening_balance_locked AS "openingBalanceEditable",created_at AS "createdAt",updated_at AS "updatedAt",
    balance::text AS "currentBalance" FROM account_balances ORDER BY created_at ASC,id ASC

plans.name: stress/budgets service
plans.sql:
WITH selected AS (
  SELECT b.*,c.name AS category_name FROM expense_tracker.budgets b
  JOIN expense_tracker.categories c ON c.id=b.category_id AND (c.is_system OR c.user_id=b.user_id)
  WHERE b.user_id=$1 AND ($2::int IS NULL OR b.year=$2) AND ($3::int IS NULL OR b.month=$3)
    AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR b.id=$4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR b.category_id=$5)
), spending AS (
  SELECT b.id,COALESCE(sum(t.amount),0::numeric) AS spent FROM selected b
  LEFT JOIN expense_tracker.transactions t ON t.user_id=b.user_id AND t.category_id=b.category_id AND t.type='expense'
    AND t.transaction_date>=make_date(b.year,b.month,1)
    AND t.transaction_date<(make_date(b.year,b.month,1)+interval '1 month')::date
  GROUP BY b.id
) SELECT b.id,b.category_id AS "categoryId",b.category_name AS "categoryName",b.amount::text,
  b.year,b.month,b.alert_threshold_percent AS "alertThresholdPercent",s.spent::text,
  (b.amount-s.spent)::text AS remaining,round(s.spent*100/b.amount,2)::text AS "percentUsed",
  CASE WHEN s.spent>b.amount THEN 'exceeded'
    WHEN s.spent>0 AND s.spent*100>=b.alert_threshold_percent*b.amount THEN 'near_limit' ELSE 'normal' END AS status,
  b.created_at AS "createdAt",b.updated_at AS "updatedAt"
  FROM selected b JOIN spending s USING(id) ORDER BY b.category_name,b.category_id,b.id

plans.name: stress/analytics breakdown getSummary
plans.sql:
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE type='income'),0::numeric) AS income,
      COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE type='expense'),0::numeric) AS expenses
    FROM expense_tracker.transactions WHERE user_id=$1 AND transaction_date BETWEEN $2::date AND $3::date
      AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR account_id=$4)
  ) SELECT income::text,expenses::text,
        (income-expenses)::text AS "netSavings",
        round((income-expenses)*100/NULLIF(income,0),2)::text AS "savingsRatePercent",
        round(expenses/$5::numeric,2)::text AS "averageDailyExpense" FROM totals

plans.name: stress/analytics breakdown getCashFlowSeries
plans.sql:
WITH months AS (
        SELECT month::date AS month FROM generate_series(date_trunc('month',$2::date::timestamp),
          date_trunc('month',$3::date::timestamp),interval '1 month') month
      ), actuals AS (
        SELECT date_trunc('month',transaction_date::timestamp)::date AS month,
          sum(amount) FILTER(WHERE type='income') AS income,sum(amount) FILTER(WHERE type='expense') AS expenses
        FROM expense_tracker.transactions WHERE user_id=$1 AND transaction_date BETWEEN $2::date AND $3::date
          AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR account_id=$4) GROUP BY 1
      ) SELECT to_char(m.month,'YYYY-MM') AS period,to_char(GREATEST(m.month,$2::date),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "from",
        to_char(LEAST((m.month+interval '1 month')::date-1,$3::date),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "to",
        COALESCE(a.income,0)::text AS income,COALESCE(a.expenses,0)::text AS expenses,
        (COALESCE(a.income,0)-COALESCE(a.expenses,0))::text AS "netSavings"
        FROM months m LEFT JOIN actuals a USING(month) ORDER BY m.month

plans.name: stress/analytics breakdown getCategoryBreakdown
plans.sql:
WITH categories AS (
        SELECT t.type,c.id AS "categoryId",c.name AS "categoryName",sum(t.amount) AS amount
        FROM expense_tracker.transactions t JOIN expense_tracker.categories c ON c.id=t.category_id AND (c.is_system OR c.user_id=t.user_id)
        WHERE t.user_id=$1 AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN $2::date AND $3::date AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR t.account_id=$4)
        GROUP BY t.type,c.id,c.name
      ) SELECT type,"categoryId","categoryName",amount::text,
        round(amount*100/NULLIF(sum(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY type),0),2)::text AS percentage
        FROM categories ORDER BY type,categories.amount DESC,"categoryId"

plans.name: stress/analytics breakdown getAccountActivity
plans.sql:
WITH actuals AS (
        SELECT account_id,sum(amount) FILTER(WHERE type='income') AS income,sum(amount) FILTER(WHERE type='expense') AS expenses
        FROM expense_tracker.transactions WHERE user_id=$1 AND transaction_date BETWEEN $2::date AND $3::date
          AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR account_id=$4) GROUP BY account_id
      ), movements AS (
        SELECT destination_account_id AS account_id,amount AS incoming,0::numeric AS outgoing FROM expense_tracker.transfers
          WHERE user_id=$1 AND date BETWEEN $2::date AND $3::date
        UNION ALL SELECT source_account_id,0::numeric,amount FROM expense_tracker.transfers
          WHERE user_id=$1 AND date BETWEEN $2::date AND $3::date
      ), movement_totals AS (SELECT account_id,sum(incoming) AS incoming,sum(outgoing) AS outgoing FROM movements GROUP BY account_id)
      SELECT a.id AS "accountId",a.name AS "accountName",a.type,COALESCE(t.income,0)::text AS income,
        COALESCE(t.expenses,0)::text AS expenses,(COALESCE(t.income,0)-COALESCE(t.expenses,0))::text AS "netSavings",
        COALESCE(m.incoming,0)::text AS "incomingTransfers",COALESCE(m.outgoing,0)::text AS "outgoingTransfers"
      FROM expense_tracker.accounts a LEFT JOIN actuals t ON t.account_id=a.id LEFT JOIN movement_totals m ON m.account_id=a.id
      WHERE a.user_id=$1 AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR a.id=$4) ORDER BY a.name,a.id
